add_library(3rdparty_protobuf INTERFACE)
if (USE_SYSTEM_PROTOBUF)
	pkg_check_modules(PROTOBUF REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET protobuf>=33.0.0)
	target_link_libraries(3rdparty_protobuf INTERFACE PkgConfig::PROTOBUF)
	set(PROTOBUF_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/rpcs3/Emu/NP/generated")
	execute_process(COMMAND protoc --cpp_out=${PROTOBUF_DIR} --proto_path=${PROTOBUF_DIR} np2_structs.proto RESULT_VARIABLE PROTOBUF_CMD_ERROR)
	if(PROTOBUF_CMD_ERROR AND NOT PROTOBUF_CMD_ERROR EQUAL 0)
		message(FATAL_ERROR "protoc failed to regenerate protobuf files.")
	endif()
else()
	option(protobuf_INSTALL "Install protobuf binaries and files" OFF)
	option(protobuf_BUILD_TESTS "Build tests" OFF)
	option(protobuf_BUILD_CONFORMANCE "Build conformance tests" OFF)
	option(protobuf_BUILD_EXAMPLES "Build examples" OFF)
	option(protobuf_BUILD_PROTOBUF_BINARIES "Build protobuf libraries and protoc compiler" ON)
	option(protobuf_BUILD_PROTOC_BINARIES "Build libprotoc and protoc compiler" OFF)
	option(protobuf_BUILD_LIBPROTOC "Build libprotoc" OFF)
	option(protobuf_BUILD_LIBUPB "Build libupb" OFF)
	option(protobuf_ALLOW_CCACHE "Adjust build flags to allow for ccache support." ON)
	option(protobuf_DISABLE_RTTI "Remove runtime type information in the binaries" OFF)
	option(protobuf_FORCE_FETCH_DEPENDENCIES "Force all dependencies to be downloaded from GitHub.  Local installations will be ignored." OFF)
	option(protobuf_LOCAL_DEPENDENCIES_ONLY "Prevent downloading any dependencies from GitHub. If this option is set, the dependency must be available locally as an installed package." OFF)
	option(protobuf_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS "Build Shared Libraries" OFF)
	option(protobuf_MSVC_STATIC_RUNTIME "Link static runtime libraries" OFF)

	# PocoS3 Android: protobuf is completely eliminated from the build.
	# On Android, 3rdparty_protobuf stays as an empty INTERFACE target
	# (no include dirs, no libprotobuf link, no regenerate_np2_protobuf
	# custom target). The NP module's protobuf-using .cpp files are
	# excluded from rpcs3_emu (see rpcs3/Emu/CMakeLists.txt) and replaced
	# with stubs in rpcs3/Emu/NP/np_android_stubs.cpp.
	if(NOT ANDROID)
		add_subdirectory(protobuf EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
		target_include_directories(3rdparty_protobuf SYSTEM INTERFACE protobuf/src)
		target_link_libraries(3rdparty_protobuf INTERFACE libprotobuf)

		# The pre-generated np2_structs.pb.h/.cc in rpcs3/Emu/NP/generated were
		# generated by an older protobuf (PROTOBUF_VERSION=6033004 = 6.33.0+4) but
		# the bundled submodule is a NEWER version (PROTOBUF_VERSION=7037000 = 7.37.0).
		# This causes "no template named 'ClassDataLite' in namespace google::protobuf::internal"
		# compile errors because protobuf 7.x renamed ClassDataLite<N> to ClassData.
		# Solution: regenerate np2_structs.pb.h/.cc using the just-built protoc binary.
		set(NP_PROTOBUF_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../rpcs3/Emu/NP/generated")
		find_program(HOST_PROTOC protoc PATHS /usr/local/bin /usr/bin REQUIRED)
		message(STATUS "PocoS3: Using host protoc: ${HOST_PROTOC}")
		add_custom_command(
			OUTPUT "${NP_PROTOBUF_DIR}/np2_structs.pb.h.stamp"
			COMMAND ${HOST_PROTOC} --cpp_out=${NP_PROTOBUF_DIR} --proto_path=${NP_PROTOBUF_DIR} np2_structs.proto
			COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E touch "${NP_PROTOBUF_DIR}/np2_structs.pb.h.stamp"
			DEPENDS "${NP_PROTOBUF_DIR}/np2_structs.proto"
			COMMENT "Regenerating np2_structs.pb.h/.cc using host protoc"
		)
		add_custom_target(regenerate_np2_protobuf DEPENDS "${NP_PROTOBUF_DIR}/np2_structs.pb.h.stamp")
		# rpcs3_emu dependency on regenerate_np2_protobuf is wired in the root
		# CMakeLists.txt AFTER add_subdirectory(third_party/rpcs3) creates rpcs3_emu.
	endif()
endif()
